maria (releases): Heads-up: prepping RC build for airgap/offline installer. Need to coordinate image pinning, cosign sigs, and release notes. Targeting change window Tue 03/31 21:00 UTC. Who's available for final sign-off?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: create-release candidate/2026-03-31-rc -> artifacts created (images, bundle). Status: pending manual approvals.

oliver (eng-runtime): I'll do image pins and manifest stamp. Will push pinned-manifests:v2026-03-31 to staging registry by EOD today.

raj (eng-infra): Can we shift the window to 21:00? maintenance blackout for APAC ends 21:30, prefer earlier start. Also need 30m for post-deploy smoke tests.

maria (releases): OK let's target 21:00 UTC then. Leave 60m window to be safe.

eve (qa): I'll run the airgap install smoke checks on a bare-metal node. Test list: boot, healthcheck endpoints, key rotation. Need the cosign public key before I start.

dmitri (security): Uploading cosign pub key to internal vault now. Key ID: cosign-redwood-rc-2026-03-31. @eve I'll DM the vault path.

oliver (eng-runtime): Note: quantized runtime variant included (q8_0). We'll keep non-quantized fallback in bundle. Please confirm fallback policy in release notes.

maria (releases): Yes include fallback: 'on capacity shortage, fallback to cpu-safe variant + degrade tokens'. Add config snippet.

maria (releases): ```yaml
fallback_policy:
  fallback_model: redwood/rw-small:non-quant
  max_latency_ms: 2500
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: manual approval requested from: maria, dmitri, eve. Use /approve-release 1773456789 to continue.

dmitri (security): Approved. Verified cosign signatures, checksum OK.

eve (qa): Approved. QA smoke check passed on staging-3 node. Logs attached: https://internal.docs/redwood/airgap-rc-smoke-1773456789

raj (eng-infra): Approved. Infra: network policies applied, load balancer prep done.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release: candidate/2026-03-31 RC promoted -> private-artifact-store. Notifications sent to eng-oncall and customers on private plan. Job duration: 12m. :tada:

oliver (eng-runtime): After deploy, follow-up tasks: update console dropdown for 'Private installer 2026-03-31', bump docs, and create pinned image tag alias.

maria (releases): I'll draft release notes and post to #announcements in morning. Add rollback plan: 'revert manifest to v2026-03-24, redeploy installer bundle, notify customers'.

sre-oncall (bot): sre-oncall: noted. Paging policy: if errors > 5% within 15m, escalate to oncall @sre-rotation.

raj (eng-infra): Also opening a short incident runbook in runbook repo: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/airgap-rc-2026-03-31.md

maria (releases): :thumbsup: Thanks team. Will post final checklist in the thread 1hr before window.
